title: OCPNODE-4620: backport blob-level mirror fallback in dockerImageSource
body:
Backport blob-level mirror fallback support #845 for OCP 4.22.
Also backport for CI: https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/pull/1026

Signed-off-by: Qi Wang [qiwan@redhat.com](mailto:qiwan@redhat.com)

comments.body: @mtrmac With #1026, it failed https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/actions/runs/31422419891/job/93566703334, is it flaky?

Yes … `quay.io` accesses fail quite frequently with server errors, and here’s also `registry.k8s.io`. (Compare e894dac8cf454fd8651e29617bf81f997b230169 in the Skopeo repo, it might be useful to backport that on a Skopeo branch.)
